## Personality

Bertha Shirley possessed a distinct talent for letter writing. Her correspondence was notable for capturing and embodying her charming personality.

## History

Bertha Shirley was rarely separated from her partner, Walter [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), during their courtship. The two married and lived very happily together until her early death. After her passing, a bundle of love letters written between her and Walter was preserved at the small yellow house where her daughter, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), was born, allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to eventually read them and feel truly connected to her parents for the first time.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P1](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0001), [v3 ch.Yesterday P2](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0002), [v3 ch.Yesterday P3](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0003), [v3 ch.Yesterday P5](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0005), [v3 ch.Yesterday P7](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0007), [v3 ch.Yesterday P8](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0008), +11 more_
